headline: Head of the State Tax Service opposes introducing a windfall tax on bank profits
summary: Almambet Shykmamatov, head of the State Tax Service, spoke against a proposal to introduce a windfall tax on bank super-profits, saying it could have negative effects.
why: A windfall tax on banks would raise the tax burden on lenders' earnings, affecting profitability and the outlook for the banking sector.
original_headline: Глава ГНС выступил против введения налога на сверхприбыль банков
